description: Create lib/vehiclehud_lib.lua - the reusable gauge rendering library with all drawing functions, vehicle database, color utilities, and vehicle type detection
steps: Create lib/vehiclehud_lib.lua with module table M = {} and return M at end, following the pattern from lib/chatengine_lib.lua and lib/worldtoscreen_lib.lua

Implement VEHICLE_DATABASE table containing all SA-MP vehicle model IDs (400-611) with fields: name (string), maxSpeed (number in km/h), type (string: 'Car', 'Bike', 'Boat', 'Plane', 'Helicopter', 'Bicycle', 'Trailer'). Include all 212 vehicles.
Implement M.getVehicleName(modelId) - returns vehicle name from VEHICLE_DATABASE or 'Unknown' if not found
Implement M.getVehicleType(modelId) - returns vehicle type string from VEHICLE_DATABASE or 'Car' as default
Implement M.getMaxSpeed(modelId) - returns max speed for gauge scaling based on vehicle type
Implement M.lerpColor(color1, color2, t) - linearly interpolate between two ARGB uint32 colors, decompose channels, lerp each, recompose
Implement M.smoothValue(current, target, speed) - returns current + (target - current) * speed, for needle interpolation

Implement M.drawArcGauge(dl, cx, cy, radius, minAngle, maxAngle, value, maxValue, options) - draws a semicircle arc gauge background using dl:AddLine segments. Options: thickness, bgColor, fgColor, segments (default 60)
Implement M.drawNeedle(dl, cx, cy, radius, angle, options) - draws a solid red needle line from center to arc edge at given angle. Options: color (default red 0xFFFF3333), thickness, length

Implement M.drawTickMarks(dl, cx, cy, radius, count, options) - draws evenly spaced tick marks along the arc. Options: minAngle, maxAngle, innerRadius, outerRadius, color, majorEvery (for longer ticks), colorZones (table of {startTick, endTick, color} for green/yellow/red zones)

Implement M.drawSpeedNumbers(dl, cx, cy, radius, maxSpeed, interval, currentAngle, options) - draws speed labels (0, 20, 40... maxSpeed) along the arc at the correct angles. Options: minAngle, maxAngle, color, fontSize offset

Implement M.drawHealthBar(dl, x, y, width, height, percent, options) - draws a horizontal health bar with background and fill. Options: bgColor, fillColor, borderColor, rounding. Color shifts green->yellow->red based on percent.
Implement M.angleForValue(value, maxValue, minAngle, maxAngle) - utility to convert a speed value to the corresponding angle on the arc
Implement M.getGearFromSpeed(speedKmh, vehicleType) - estimate gear (1-6) from speed and vehicle type using speed thresholds
Implement M.getHeadingDirection(heading) - convert heading degrees (0-360) to cardinal direction string (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW)
acceptance_criteria: lib/vehiclehud_lib.lua exists and has valid Lua syntax (passes luajit -bl)
VEHICLE_DATABASE contains entries for model IDs 400 through 611 with name, maxSpeed, and type fields

All public functions (drawArcGauge, drawNeedle, drawTickMarks, drawSpeedNumbers, drawHealthBar, lerpColor, smoothValue, getVehicleType, getVehicleName, getMaxSpeed, getGearFromSpeed, getHeadingDirection, angleForValue) are defined on the module table M
Drawing functions use dl:AddLine and dl:AddText patterns consistent with PlayerStatsWidget.lua DrawList usage
No pcall used inside any drawing function (MonetLoader constraint)
Module returns M table at the end
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/samp-android-lua-script && luajit -bl lib/vehiclehud_lib.lua > /dev/null 2>&1; echo $?  (should output 0)
Verify VEHICLE_DATABASE has entries for IDs 400-611 by grepping for key model IDs like 411 (Infernus), 560 (Sultan), 481 (BMX)
